violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play
violation_type.typical_finding: Children were observed to not have water made available to them during their outside time.

finding_variants.text: Children were observed to not have water made available to them during their outside time.
Water was not available to children during lunch time.
Children were not observed to be served anything to drink with meal and water was not observed to be available.
Based on the information obtained during the investigation it was determined that children are withheld their milk and water after playing outside, until they have eaten at least half of their lunch.

A classroom was observed during active play outside without water available. This was corrected at inspection with water being brought to them from their classroom during their outside activites after prompted by child care regulation.
3 classes that went outside to play did not take water for the children to drink as required. The director corrected this during the inspection.

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: Two group of children were engaging in outdoor activities without a supply of water for drinking available.  The staff corrected the deficiency during the inspection when a staff member brought a supply of drinking water and disposal cups to serve children water during outdoor play.  Having a supply of drinking water available to serve children during outdoor may mitigate risk of dehydration.

Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking water available at every snack, mealtime, and during and after active play: A classroom was observed during active play outside without water available.
